title: Slice 5A — Governed Agentic Routing Foundation
scientific_question: In which query classes, under which costs and risks, does a dynamic routing policy surpass, complement, or worsen fixed RAG strategies?
experimental: Deterministic routing policy selecting per-query strategy

constraints.sample_size_caveat: n=8 does NOT permit general superiority claims

oracle_disclaimer: Post-hoc oracle is a CEILING ONLY — not a deployable policy. It uses evaluation outcomes that are unavailable at inference time.

future_levels.L4: Single agent with tool retrieval — NOT multi-agent
